titleEn: All Divisions With the Highest Score of a Binary Array
title: 分组得分最高的所有下标
summary: 在二进制数组任一边界切分，得分为左侧零数量加右侧一数量，返回所有最高分切分下标。
insight: 切分零处得分是全数组一的数量。边界每右移一格，跨过零则得分加一，跨过一则得分减一；在线维护最大值和对应下标。
pitfalls: 切分下标包括零和 n

solutions.title: 增量切分得分
solutions.idea: 从空左侧开始逐边界更新得分。
steps: 遍历 split=0..n：先比较并维护答案
若 split<n，跨过 nums[split]：零使 score++，一使 score--

code.java: class Solution { public List<Integer> maxScoreIndices(int[] nums){int score=0;for(int value:nums)score+=value;int maximum=-1;List<Integer> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(int split=0;split<=nums.length;split++){if(score>maximum){maximum=score;answer.clear();answer.add(split);}else if(score==maximum)answer.add(split);if(split<nums.length)score+=nums[split]==0?1:-1;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxScoreIndices(nums:IntArray):List<Int>{var score=nums.sum();var maximum=-1;val answer=mutableListOf<Int>();for(split in 0..nums.size){if(score>maximum){maximum=score;answer.clear();answer.add(split)}else if(score==maximum)answer.add(split);if(split<nums.size)score+=if(nums[split]==0)1 else -1};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:vector<int> maxScoreIndices(vector<int>& nums){int score=accumulate(nums.begin(),nums.end(),0),maximum=-1;vector<int> answer;for(int split=0;split<=(int)nums.size();++split){if(score>maximum){maximum=score;answer={split};}else if(score==maximum)answer.push_back(split);if(split<(int)nums.size())score+=nums[split]? -1:1;}return answer;} };
